sections.content: How many people are "managers and directors in retail and wholesale"?

462,965 people

were counted on the census as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" in England and Wales in March 2021.

This makes this type of work the sixth most common occupation reported on the census.

Retail and wholesale managers and directors organise and co-ordinate the operations of major retail and wholesale establishments in order to maximise business performance and meet financial goals.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale", 13.4% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" was 16 to 19 years.

  • social workers
  • information technology trainers
  • betting shop and gambling establishment managers

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" there were more men than women (62.5% compared with 37.5%).

This means "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "corporate managers and directors".

Men made up 62.5% and women made up 37.5% of "managers and directors in retail and wholesale"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" included:

  • chemical scientists
  • quality control and planning engineers
  • food, drink and tobacco process operatives

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "managers and directors in retail and wholesale", 8.1% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (81.2% compared with 18.8%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (81.6%) than self-employed (18.4%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
